subject.title: Skill Workshop approval succeeds in Control UI but independent operator list/replay stays empty

question: Which paired operator devices should be authorized to discover and resolve a plugin approval created by another connection?
rationale: Current code deliberately limits visibility to prevent cross-client replay, but the existing product flow gives independent eligible operators no actionable route; changing the reviewer set defines an authorization and information-disclosure boundary that source inspection alone cannot choose.

options.title: Enroll eligible reviewer devices
options.body: Keep device-bound records, but snapshot or dynamically enroll paired devices with the required approval scope and replay authorized records to them on list and reconnect.

options.title: Expose to every scoped operator
options.body: Let any paired client with `operator.approvals` list and resolve pending requests, accepting the broader disclosure and authorization surface.

options.title: Keep requester-bound visibility
options.body: Retain the current restriction and add explicit initiating-surface routing instructions without independent listing or replay.

recommendation.title: Enroll eligible reviewer devices
recommendation.body: Keep device-bound records, but snapshot or dynamically enroll paired devices with the required approval scope and replay authorized records to them on list and reconnect.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent approval-manager security hardening makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the authorization-boundary decision.
